Patient: Yuonne Dooley
Hospital ID: P018
Date of birth: 6 February 1994
Date of visit: 6 October 2021

Dear Doctor,

I reviewed this 27-year-old woman in the medical clinic today. Her background includes hypertension.

She is allergic to animal dander, which causes hay fever symptoms. She is allergic to bee venom, which causes skin rash. She is allergic to grass pollen. She is allergic to house dust mite. She is allergic to mould, which causes wheezing. She is allergic to tree pollen.

She continues on ibuprofen 400 mg three times a day. She is on amlodipine 2.5 mg once a day. Her levonorgestrel was stopped on 6 December 2020.

Plan: no changes today. Review in clinic in three months.

Yours sincerely,
Medical Outpatient Clinic
